artworks.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire Seen beyond the Wall of the Jas de Bouffan
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: The Little Bridge [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of intersecting tree trunks and branches. The point of view is eye level, looking at a collection of bare trees dominating the composition. In the distance, there is a suggestion of a building with a slanted roofline. The horizon line is not distinct, creating a continuous flow into the trees and building. Closest to us, at the bottom of the drawing, a small arched bridge or structure emerges. The drawing features a monochromatic color palette with varying intensities of pencil marks to convey form and shadow, giving it a raw and natural feel.

artworks.title: Bust of Madame Cezanne [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The drawing displays the upper body of a person, with a focus on their head and shoulders. The individual appears angled, potentially seated and leaning slightly forward with their head tilted downwards. They have closed eyes, a relaxed mouth, wavy hair, and are wearing a jacket with a high collar. Next to the person lies a round object, casting a shadow on a flat surface. The background is plain without any other details.

artworks.title: Wash Basin and Scent Bottle [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image features a large bowl and a smaller bottle, drawn in pencil with varying shades of gray. The bowl is positioned centrally and slightly to the right, with the bottle to the left. Both objects are placed on a flat surface with some shading in the background.

artworks.title: Seated Bather [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in different poses. The figure on the left is seated, leaning slightly to the side with one arm behind. The middle figure is also seated, while the figure on the right is reclining. Each figure has distinct facial features and various hair lengths. The sketch focuses on the figures, with a minimal background of simple lines hinting at a landscape or horizon.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper (sketchbook page)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's head, showing only his face and part of his neck. He is depicted in a three-quarter view, facing towards the right-hand side of the image. The man has a prominent bald forehead with some hair on the back and sides of his head. His facial features include a wide nose, deep-set eyes, and a thick, full beard and mustache, drawn with dark pencil strokes. The sketch is on a plain, unadorned background.

artworks.title: The Artist's Father and Objects on a Mantel [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper (sketchbook page)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a clock, books or papers, and a glass on a flat surface. The sketch features shades of gray on a beige background. The clock is in the center, with papers or books to its right, and a glass on the right side near a sketched profile of a person wearing a hat.

artworks.title: Trees Leaning over Rocks
artworks.medium: watercolor and black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This image shows a view from below looking upward through a canopy of slender, arching trees. The horizon is not prominently defined, as the focus is on the upward view amid the trees. The image is executed with loose, sketchy strokes, using thin lines and faint washes of color to suggest the trees and their leaves. The color palette includes cool blues, soft greens, and hints of earthy browns. There is a sense of openness and tranquility created by the sparseness of detail and large areas of white space in the background.

artworks.title: Three Dancers Resting
artworks.medium: black chalk and pastel on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing shows three dancers in ballet attire. Two on the left are sitting, with their heads turned toward each other and their legs outstretched. The third dancer on the right is turned away from them, her knees bent, appearing to stretch. The scene is mostly drawn in thin gray lines on light brown paper. However, some areas are shaded in bright colors, such as blue, pink, and white. Some of these highlights are on the dancer's costumes or shoes, while some are on their hair and limbs.

artworks.title: Three Studies of Ludovic Halévy Standing
artworks.medium: charcoal on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of three men shown from the back. Each man is standing with a slight forward lean, their arms resting beside them or tucked in. The men wear top hats and long coats. The men's facial features and hair are not visible. The background is plain, emphasizing the sketched figures.

artworks.title: The Harvest
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a field leading towards a town or city in the distance, with a horizon line showing rows of rooftops. Towers and chimneys release smoke against the otherwise clear sky. Closer to us, the large field is depicted with short vertical strokes suggesting grass or crops, with tall, tied bundles interspersed throughout the space. In the center of the field, a person in a hat holds a long scythe and cuts a path through the field. Another person seems to be behind them, facing away from us. The people are drawn with simple lines and little detail, as is the rest of the drawing. The background is beige paper.

artworks.title: An Open Carriage
artworks.medium: black wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage with two horses. In the foreground, there are two horses harnessed to an ornate carriage. The carriage has elaborate detailing. The horses are depicted with dynamic lines suggesting movement. The background is a muted wash indicating a busy street scene. The medium used is likely pencil with washes, creating a soft, atmospheric effect capturing the elegance and sophistication of a bygone era in transportation.

artworks.title: Military Parade
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military scene involving horses. The drawing depicts a group of uniformed individuals, some on horseback and some standing. The central figure is seated on a horse, and there are others nearby who are either mounted or standing. The figures appear to be in a formal military setting. The use of grayscale tones and shading provides depth. The background features indistinct sketchy lines.

artworks.title: Promenade in the Bois
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: Three individuals are riding horses along a path. The person in the center is wearing a tall top hat and the individuals on the sides are wearing wide-brimmed hats with feathers. The individuals are wearing period-appropriate clothing. The background shows a natural setting with trees and an open sky. Additional figures are vaguely visible in the distance to the right.

artworks.title: Coachmen
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in ornate clothing. Three are seated together, while the fourth is seated separately facing them. The figures have indistinct facial features and wear extravagant hats with feathers. They wear elaborate coats and breeches with bold red and blue patterns. Each figure wears a prominent tricorn hat and at least one holds a staff. The setting seems to be indoors with an abstract blue background suggesting a wall or draped fabric. There are hints of furniture, including a table with a decorative chess piece-like structure on it.

artworks.title: The Brighton Coach
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue and green wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage with multiple figures seated atop it and additional horses in the background. The scene depicts a busy moment with the active pulling of horses and the presence of numerous hats worn by the figures. The artist used pen and ink strokes, possibly enhanced with watercolor, to illustrate movement and the ambiance of travel. The background is lightly hinted at by sporadic lines. The overall impression evokes a dynamic scene from a past era with a focus on the motion and energy of the depicted subjects.

artworks.title: The Strawberry Roans
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage. The drawing depicts an elegant carriage being pulled by a team of four horses. The carriage is shown in detail, with large wheels and ornate decorations. Two figures are seated at the front of the carriage, holding the reins. The background features a building with steps leading up to large double doors, flanked by windows. The style of the drawing is characteristic of a period setting, and the line work is detailed, with fluid strokes that capture the movement of the horses and the elaborate structure of the carriage.

artworks.title: A Sprig of Plums
artworks.medium: charcoal and black chalk with stumping and scratching out on cream wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Spectators at the Grand Prix
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 23 x 17.5 cm (9 1/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people primarily seen from the waist up, although some individuals are shown in full length. The central figure is facing to the right, standing in a carriage while wearing a long-sleeved white dress with tiered ruffles. Her face is depicted in profile, and she has short, dark hair under a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a ribbon. Next to her, another woman also stands wearing a white dress and a similar wide-brimmed hat, her face facing forward. Below them is another individual sitting in the carriage, wearing a brown outfit and holding a black umbrella. The scene includes several other figures in the background, some wearing dark coats, top hats, or holding umbrellas. The carriage they are in is dark with a visible wheel and lantern. The background features a crowd of people softly painted in varying shades, suggesting a bustling outdoor setting with muted tones blending into an understated, impressionistic sky.

artworks.title: Grenoble
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over black chalk
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 16.5 x 51.5 cm (6 1/2 x 20 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a river with a bridge, a distant town, and mountains. The horizon line divides the composition. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, conveying movement and texture. The color palette is soft and muted with earthy tones, purple, and orange in the sky.

artworks.title: A Stream Running between Houses and a Road
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Two Apples
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: In this painting, two apples are depicted on a light brown surface. The apples appear yellow with red and green highlights. One apple is positioned in the upper left corner, while the other is closer to the lower right corner. They cast faint shadows on the surface below them.

artworks.title: Cucumber with Leaves
artworks.medium: watercolor and gray wash on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: The Road from Versailles to Louveciennes
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a street view from a slightly elevated position. The tan path is lined with a few trees and houses. On the right, two people in dark dresses are walking along the street, and on the left we can see the side of a white house. More buildings with red roofs are visible in the distance, down the path that stretches from the bottom right corner into the center of the image. The sky is mostly white paper, with a few streaks of blue. The color palette is soft and muted, with browns, greens, pale blues, and touches of red, and the brushstrokes are loose and fluid.
